text:
maria: FYI customer on POC reports Console live-tail shows logs but no trace IDs, can't correlate to spans. They forwarded a sample: {"ts":"2026-03-21T10:02:11Z","level":"info","msg":"invoke","meta":{"req_id":"r-123","user":"acct-9"}} — no trace field.

tyler: Two likely causes: SDK header not propagated (x-trace-id/x-request-id) OR log forwarder is flattening/dropping nested meta.

alex: If they're using a gateway it might rewrite headers. Confirm gateway preserves x-request-id and forwards to Redwood.

pranav: Troubleshooting steps: 1) Enable Console live-tail debug (Console -> Logs -> Live -> DEBUG 30m). 2) Set LOG_FORWARDER_RAW=true on their drain to avoid flattening. 3) Ensure forwarder mapping rule: json.trace_id = meta.trace_id || headers.x-request-id.

maria: How do we flip LOG_FORWARDER_RAW on hosted drains?

tyler: We can push an override on the drain token. Example I run: curl -X POST "https://console.redwood-inference.internal/drains/DR-123/override" -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" -d '{"raw":true}'

infra-bot: log-drain DR-123: override applied by tyler at 2026-03-21T10:03:01Z (status: pending-restart) :gear:

alex: If they use grok or regex parsing in ELK it will strip keys. Recommend json parser + decode_json_fields and rename x-request-id -> trace_id. Example mapping pasted in DM.

pranav: Also check sampling on the drain — disable sampling for the POC window to avoid dropped correlations.

sara: I can screenshare with their devops at 10:30 PT to walk ELK mapping. Want an invite?

maria: Yes. Also they reported 429s during long live-tail sessions.

tyler: Live-tail counts against stream concurrency. For POC we can add +2 stream quota for 24h or suggest shorter tails. I'll apply +2 for acct-acme.

infra-bot: quota-update: streams +2 applied to acct-acme for 24h by tyler at 2026-03-21T10:03:22Z

pranav: One gotcha: some gateways use capitalization X-Request-Id. Normalize headers with lowercase_headers: true in pipeline.

maria: Action items — tyler: flip LOG_FORWARDER_RAW and add +2 streams; sara: screenshare at 10:30 PT; pranav: confirm gateway header behavior and share forwarder snippet. Customer will upload 10 raw sample lines to secure share.

tyler: If mapping still fails paste a redacted raw line here and we'll iterate.

maria: Closing thread for now, will reopen if unresolved. :white_check_mark:
